headline: An Agentic Playbook Hunts Bugs Responsibly
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized penetration testing into a disciplined agent workflow. Its 83 skills, vulnerability patterns, evidence checks, and reporting templates give researchers a structured path from reconnaissance to disclosure.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents A Method
lede: Superpowers replaces improvised code generation with an engineered sequence: discover requirements, validate the design, plan the work, then execute tested tasks. Worktrees, subagents, and explicit review keep autonomy inside a verifiable process.

headline: CLI-Anything Makes Software Agent-Ready
lede: CLI-Anything wraps desktop applications, games, services, and developer tools in structured command-line harnesses. Its registry and validation loops give agents a rugged route from natural-language intent to real, testable artifacts.

headline: MiniMind Builds A Language Model From Scratch
lede: MiniMind lays out the entire small-model construction plan, from tokenizer and pretraining to alignment, distillation, and serving. A roughly 64-million-parameter model keeps the lessons affordable enough for a consumer GPU and concrete enough to inspect.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents To Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog packages agent skills, coding workflows, and business-system integrations into reusable units. The same manifest-driven model can support code review and repository maintenance, or reach into CRM, recruiting, marketing, and collaboration tools.

headline: Firecrawl Turns The Live Web Into Context
lede: Firecrawl handles the difficult plumbing between a dynamic website and an AI-ready document. Crawling, rendering, proxy rotation, structured extraction, monitoring, and interactive actions converge in one pipeline for agents and retrieval systems.

headline: NGINX Keeps The Edge Moving
lede: NGINX remains a compact engine for serving, proxying, caching, balancing, and governing traffic. Its master-worker architecture, modular build, and text configuration deliver control without surrendering throughput or operational clarity.

headline: OpenVINO Squeezes More From Inference
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training ecosystems into optimized representations for Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs. Quantization, sparsity, serving, and broad language-model integrations make deployment efficiency the central measurement.

headline: Diagram Design Makes Architecture Presentable
lede: Diagram Design turns a plain-language brief into a polished standalone HTML and SVG composition. Forty-four diagram types, grid-aware placement, overlap checks, and brand extraction give agent-made visuals a deliberate visual system.

headline: The Last Thirty Days Become A Brief
lede: Last30days-skill compresses scattered signals from communities, markets, video, news, research, and code into an evidence-grounded report. Parallel searches and attributable source material turn recency into a usable research instrument.
